description: DRAFT — closes the gap noted in src/lib/flow-schema.ts: the TIME trigger exists in TriggerType but never had a lexicon. Fires at a time of day while the app is foregrounded (or via the hub, once it schedules pushes). Shape mirrors ScheduleTriggerDetails in src/types/index.ts.
